title: Calculate your SAE admission chances
tagline: Enter your preference list and estimate your chances of getting a place. This research tool helps you decide; it does not replace or submit your official SAE application.

welcome.headline: Enter your preference list and calculate your admission chances.
welcome.subline: If you do not have your preference list yet — no worries, we will help you out.
welcome.question: Do you already have your preference list?

finish.title: You're done
finish.lead: You have reviewed your chances. This is the list you ended up with.
finish.chanceLabel: Your estimated chance of being assigned
finish.staleNote: Go back to the result to calculate your chances with the current list.
finish.listEmpty: You have not added any programs to your list yet.
finish.official: Remember: this tool submits nothing. To apply for real, enter your list on the official SAE website before the deadline.

aboutEstimate.title: About this estimate
aboutEstimate.body: The model uses historical 2024 calibration data and 2025 capacity data. Results are estimates, not official admission guarantees.
aboutEstimate.mtbMode: For the 2026 admission process, the tie-breaking lottery is reproduced from your RUN/IPE at each school. Results are estimates based on last year's calibration data, not official admission guarantees.

error.title: We could not show this step
error.body: Something went wrong unexpectedly. Your entries are still in this tab, so you can try again without starting over.
